title: Batch typed Job JSON reads in the WASI adapter
question: How much complete Run time does an 8 KiB read buffer save on a large supported hosted Job?
summary: Bundled Chromium saves a median paired 0.251 seconds on the 1,034,770-byte Job. Untimed instrumentation counts 1,034,771 versus 128 reads of the same bytes. Compact median paired cost is 0.005 seconds.

workloads: Two-row CSV with a compact Job and a near-1 MiB 63-formula Job, 256 MiB and one worker.

validation.summary: Three matched pairs per shape and warmups verify exact CSV bytes, manifest, caps, completion marker and cleanup. Matched malformed error, cap-failure, larger virtual Job and production import controls pass.

limitations: One machine and bundled Chromium. Tiny CSVs isolate configuration overhead. Elapsed samples cover Run.
exclusions: Other browsers and direct claims about total job RSS, Analyze and preview latency, or large CSV throughput.
